tests.name: blank inputs reject and synthetic fixture separately marked
whole cash ledger, independent no-shock arithmetic
basic living floor plus medical and a one-off not capitalized into reserve
zero rate and one-period annuity, equal-principal and bullet
independent equal principal, bullet, and contractual custom last balloon
recurring and one-off income rows, independent job loss and linear return
floating rate only reprices as the contract prescribes; fixed rate unchanged
prepayment lowers payment or shortens term and does not double charge
prepay minimum, mandatory reserve and explicit early termination fee
negative equity sale requires top-up, and prior discharge may require gross prefunding
economic sale closes once after lag, removes rent and settles every lien once
vacancy, alternative housing/transport and locked/unmarketable assets
financial settlement and one-time loss, deposit maturity and pledged/restricted use
staged security sale, total return without duplicated dividends
cash exhaustion leaves principal and unpaid interest; pending receipts cannot fund today
unfunded voluntary consumption stops the planned path without inventing payable debt
guarantee call and debts appear at the specified month
small actual policy set, no feasible candidate, no terminal/regret ranking
input intervals must have explicit center or use an endpoint; scenario units and overlaps checked
reverse thresholds are reruns, not a score, rent-sale equality and cash prepayment bound
unconfirmed loan permissions, windows and fees suppress optional actions but preserve contract
unknown asset release, fees, wait and mortgage fees are never imputed to allow a sale
same-month approved pledged liquidation retires margin once, including transaction and contract charges
pledged delayed closing, locked quote and top-up are reconciled at cash settlement
candidate amounts include current received wage after living cost and contractual installment
demo common feasible set, deterministic unique policies, regret and residuals
